question: Rural development mainly focuses on improving the quality of life for:
solution:
The correct answer is __**rural population**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Rural development primarily aims to improve the **quality of life and economic well-being of people living in rural areas**.
 
• The focus areas include **agriculture, education, healthcare, infrastructure, and employment opportunities** for rural communities.
 
• It targets marginalized groups such as small farmers, landless laborers, tribal populations, and women.
 
• Government schemes like **MGNREGA (Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act)** and PMAY-G (Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin) are examples of rural development initiatives.
 
• Rural development is crucial for reducing **poverty, rural-urban migration, and regional disparities** in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **MGNREGA (Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act):**

 
 
• MGNREGA provides a legal guarantee of 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to rural households.
 
• It focuses on creating durable assets like roads, canals, and water conservation structures in rural areas.
 
• This scheme aims to reduce rural poverty and promote livelihood security.
 
 
 
• **PMAY-G (Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin):**
 
 
• It aims to provide affordable housing to rural poor families with basic amenities.
 
• Financial assistance is given to beneficiaries to construct pucca houses.
 
• The scheme promotes women's ownership of houses and social inclusiveness.
 
 
 
• **National Rural Health Mission (NRHM):**
 
 
• NRHM focuses on improving healthcare facilities and reducing maternal and infant mortality in rural areas.
 
• It addresses health disparities by strengthening primary healthcare systems.
 
• Programs like ASHA workers (Accredited Social Health Activists) are key components of NRHM.
 
 
 
• **Key Challenges in Rural Development:**
 
 
• Lack of infrastructure like roads, electricity, and water supply.
 
• Low literacy rates and inadequate healthcare services.
 
• Dependence on agriculture and vulnerability to climate change.
 
• Social issues such as caste discrimination and gender inequality.
